design: Tool-free battery swap on the battery-on-cap backpack (D-037, qilinxiaoxiang/microduck_rl 8bce48af): an opening in the roof and the rear rounded top corner straight above the battery (frame and cap, across the cap seam; the cradle roof tab goes), closed by a printed hatch that restores the roof and the rounded corner flush (top z 43, back x -75.55). The cap's rounded corner overhangs the battery's rear 2 mm, so the hatch carries that corner. The hatch has two fixed front tabs under the frame roof edge (the hinge), a back flap 28 x 19 x 1.2 mm on the cap's back face whose 1.2 mm bump snaps into a slot through the cap back wall (released by pulling the flap's lower edge out about 1.3 mm, root strain 0.77 %), a wedge that holds the battery down 0.3 mm above its top, and lead notches open to the rear so neither battery lead is unplugged to open it. The two retainer bars stay screwed and are no longer removed; the switch, DFR1202 and box outline are unchanged. All three parts print in Orange.
